verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a dedicated sandbox environment and a test mode that uses testnet blockchains and simulated payments with no real assets transferred, so developers can rehearse buy/payment flows without real funds. The evidence does not show whether the sandbox covers off-ramp payouts or swaps, or whether it provides deterministic test values. Missing for 10: documented sandbox coverage of payouts/off-ramp and conversions/swaps, deterministic test values (e.g. test cards or scripted outcomes), independent or hands-on corroboration.
